eyebrow.llm_guidance: Short uppercase eyebrow, e.g. 'How we work'. Optional.

title.llm_guidance: Heading for this feature block. One phrase, under 10 words.

body.llm_guidance: One or two short paragraphs about an approach, value, or way of working — NOT a person's biography. Max 55 words.

quote.llm_guidance: An optional pull-quote. Use ONLY a real, attributable quote (or omit). Never invent a testimonial or attribute words to a person who did not say them.

attribution.llm_guidance: Source of the quote, if any. Never invent a name or a client.

image_alt.llm_guidance: Describe the line illustration for screen readers, e.g. 'A line illustration of two people reviewing a document'. The figure is a GENERIC line illustration — never a named or specific real/invented individual.

reverse.llm_guidance: Set true to place the illustration on the right instead of the left (for visual rhythm when several blocks stack). Default false.
